The new CacheSpan is guaranteed to represent the same data as the one it replaces, however file and lastTouchTimestamp may have changed. Note that for span replacement, onSpanAdded and onSpanRemoved are not called in addition to this method. Parameters Cache  cache The source of the event. CacheSpan  oldSpan The old CacheSpan , which has been removed from the cache.
